claims.claim: O'Mahony et al. observed notably lower diversity for creative-type prompts than factual ones on both of their generation metrics.
claims.source: O'Mahony, Grinsztajn, Schoelkopf and Biderman (EleutherAI / Limerick / INRIA), ICLR 2024 ME-FoMo workshop
claims.quote: lower diversity for creative type prompts for both metrics

claims.claim: O'Mahony et al. give Llama-2-chat repeating the invented word Frumplenook each time as an example of mode collapse.
claims.source: O'Mahony, Grinsztajn, Schoelkopf and Biderman (EleutherAI / Limerick / INRIA), ICLR 2024 ME-FoMo workshop
claims.quote: Llama-2-chat repeats the term “Frumplenook” each time

claims.claim: O'Mahony et al. found industrially fine-tuned models to have very poor output diversity results.
claims.source: O'Mahony, Grinsztajn, Schoelkopf and Biderman (EleutherAI / Limerick / INRIA), ICLR 2024 ME-FoMo workshop
claims.quote: find industrially fine-tuned models to have very poor output diversity results
